evaluate_implicitron_exp_dir_map: evaluate multiple Implicitron models across CO3Dv2 categories and subsets then submit results to EvalAI
evaluate_implicitron_exp_dir: evaluate a single Implicitron experiment directory on a CO3Dv2 category and subset and dump results to JSON
update_implicitron_submission_with_categ: render new view predictions for a CO3D category subset using an Implicitron model and add results to a submission
load_model_from_implicitron_exp_dir: load a trained Implicitron GenericModel from an experiment directory checkpoint and set it to eval mode
get_dataset_map: obtain a DatasetMap containing train val and test dataset objects for a CO3Dv2 category and subset
